The user wants to know if the IDE remembers the cursor position, open files, and sidebar panel visibility when reopening a project.
I have a plan with 3 phases:
1. Cursor position (T1) -> Closed: "seek, load working lines from disk". This seems to confirm the mechanism for cursor position (seek/load lines).
2. Open files (T2) -> Closed: Found mechanism "save workspace session" / "restore workspace session". Confirmed.
3. Sidebar visibility (T3) -> Closed: "no encontré la persistencia de la visibilidad de los paneles laterales; lo leído Workspace Session solo serializa pestañas abiertas... sin ningún campo para el estado de los paneles visible oculto".

The last Closed (T3) explicitly states that the mechanism for sidebar visibility was *not* found in the inspected object (Workspace Session). It says "ESA pregunta no se relanza... do=cerrar ese mapeo".
The instructions say: "Si el último Cerrado negó el mapeo. Cierra ESE mapeo (hueco o sin camino), no selles un polo que sí se leyó."
